lines.ja: 最初で最後の新婚旅行。
lines.en: Our first and last honeymoon.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: そうやんな。でも何回行ってもいいんやで、新婚旅行は。
lines.en: Yeah. But you know, you can go on honeymoons as many times as you want.
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: 新婚は１回かもしれへん。でも結婚旅行は何回でも行ける！
lines.en: Being newlyweds might be once, but we can take married trips as often as we like!
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 結婚した後も。
lines.en: Even after being married.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 結婚した後の旅行って全部結婚旅行やな。
lines.en: Any trip after getting married counts as a marriage trip, right?
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: やぁ、最高やん。
lines.en: Aww, that's the best.
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: 沖縄最初の晩ご飯は？
lines.en: Our very first dinner in Okinawa is...
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: 焼肉です！
lines.en: Yakiniku!
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 焼肉！
lines.en: Yakiniku!
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: どんだけ焼肉食うねん、どこ行っても焼肉食うやんけと思ってるそこの貴方。
lines.en: To anyone thinking, 'How much yakiniku do they eat? They eat it wherever they go!'
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: そうです。焼肉食べます！
lines.en: That's right. We're having yakiniku!
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: もとぶ牛。
lines.en: Motobu beef.
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: はい、もとぶ牛でございます。
lines.en: Yes, Motobu beef it is.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: では、沖縄一発目の乾杯。
lines.en: Now then, cheers to our first round in Okinawa.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 乾杯！
lines.en: Cheers!
lines.speaker: Wife

clips.title: First Time at a Resort Pool

lines.ja: ホテルの備え付けのプールに来ました！
lines.en: We've come to the hotel's pool!
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: やばい、リゾートや。
lines.en: Wow, this is like a real resort.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: めっちゃリゾートやん。初めてやし、こんなん。
lines.en: Total resort vibes. It's my first time at a place like this.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 最高やな。早く入ろう。
lines.en: It's awesome. Let's get in quickly.
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: 俺、市民プールのさ、流れるやつしか入ったことない。
lines.en: I've only ever been in the lazy river at public municipal pools.
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: ない、私も一緒。
lines.en: Same here, me too!
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: しかも私たち、プールも海も初めてやから。
lines.en: Besides, it's our first time visiting a pool or the sea together.
lines.speaker: Wife

lines.ja: そうやな、２人ではじめてやで！
lines.en: That's true, our very first time as a couple!
lines.speaker: Husband

lines.ja: 初めてやで。
lines.en: Our first time.
lines.speaker: Wife
